name: LKAT — Linear Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer
description: Official code of the paper 'Rethinking Vision Architectures with Gated Linear Attention and KAN'. An isotropic ViT-style encoder coupling chunk-wise Gated Linear Attention (O(N)) with KAN feed-forward blocks and a fused RBF-KAN kernel. Outperforms ViT-B/16 and Mixer-B/16 on ImageNet-100.
